item.description: The co-pilot who allegedly attempted to down a flydubai plane had been barred from flying in his home country of Oman. Initial investigations have uncovered the use of a crash axe, a tool typically used in emergencies, in the mid-flight attack.

item.title: ABC News: Sharks could linger off Perth coast despite whale carcass removal
item.description: Some of Perth's most seasoned swimmers are taking a break from the ocean amid ongoing shark sightings, after a whale carcass washed up on Monday.

item.title: ABC News: David Fifita leads Australia in wild mismatch against PNG
item.description: Australia and captain David Fifita have routed Papua New Guinea in the annual Prime Minister's XIII game in Port Moresby, while winger Jada Taylor has put her hand up for a World Cup berth after the women's team handed PNG a record loss.

item.title: ABC News: Tornado rips through NSW south coast, causing damage around Ulladulla
item.description: The Bureau of Meteorology confirms a tornado moved through the area, describing the event as "very unusual", while the SES is responding to dozens of calls across the state.

item.title: ABC News: One Nation promises law-and-order boost in Victorian campaign launch
item.description: The party pledges to boost police numbers and increase penalties for young offenders, saying it would fund the changes by scrapping the Suburban Rail Loop and Victoria's Treaty.

item.title: ABC News: Saints hit rock bottom, Essendon claim breakthrough AFLW victory
item.description: St Kilda were 90 seconds from failing to score in their AFLW clash against the Western Bulldogs, as Essendon's first win of the year leaves the Saints as the only winless team in the league.

item.title: ABC News: Olympic star takes on challengers at pool's grand reopening
item.description: A much-loved old pool has finally reopened after it was feared it might stay shut forever — and the occasion was not a moment too soon for those enjoying school holidays.

item.title: ABC News: Essendon claims breakthrough AFLW victory against GWS
item.description: Essendon has come from behind to beat GWS by eight points and claim its first win of the AFLW season, with midfielder Madison Prespakis starring.

item.title: ABC News: FOMO and 4am wake-up call get Pallister in the ocean
item.description: Lani Pallister won four gold medals and booked her spot at the world short course championships in Sydney this week, but that didn't stop her from flying to Queensland to win the Bluff to Bar ocean race.

item.title: ABC News: Highway potholes puncture tyres after Victoria's latest bout of rain
item.description: Large sharp-edged potholes have opened up along Victorian roads and highways after heavy rain across the state since Friday.

item.title: ABC News: Newcastle Knights fans have been hit by a car — here's what we know
item.description: Ten people have been injured — two of them critically — by a car that ploughed into a crowd gathered for the Newcastle Knights grand final procession. Here's what we know.

item.title: ABC News: Verity is the latest Colleen Hoover novel to get a film adaptation
item.description: From Misery to Yellowface, books and films about writers are favourites among the authors who pen them, but audiences love them too. Enter Verity, the latest film adapted from a Colleen Hoover novel.

item.title: ABC News: Australian arrested for holding 'pistol-like object' in Hong Kong
item.description: The man was reportedly on holiday with his family and had been drinking alcohol.

item.title: ABC News: How the eviction of an 87-year-old became Spain's 'last straw'
item.description: The average rental price in Spain has almost doubled over the past decade. When Maricarmen Abascal was evicted, she became the symbol of a fed-up nation.

item.title: ABC News: Police arrest man over alleged online threats after AFP searches home
item.description: A man arrested in SA's Mid North following alleged online threats towards police officers was refused bail during a court appearance on Friday, the AFP says.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Chaos at grand final gathering as car hits crowd, driver arrested
item.description: A car has crashed into a crowd of Newcastle Knights supporters as the fans lined the streets to cheer on their team for this weekend's NRL grand final.

item.title: ABC News: Concreter survives three deadly strokes, warns against ignoring symptoms
item.description: A Queensland stroke survivor is overhauling his life and spreading awareness of symptoms after nearly dying this year, as experts say rushing to hospital as soon as possible is critical.

item.title: ABC News: Inside the 'secret society' keeping the art of bellringing alive
item.description: Bellringers are set to gather in Bathurst to honour one of the world's oldest players by ringing bells for hours in a mentally and physically taxing art dating back to England in the 1600s.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Multiple injuries after car hits crowd of Knights supporters in Newcastle
item.description: Emergency services are treating multiple casualties after a car crashed into a crowd during a Newcastle Knights pre-grand final farewell.
